fusions.name: Cowcatcher
fusions.desc: Drives through with a plough frame, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Millstone Turn
fusions.desc: Drops a millstone on one enemy, which deals 32 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Yoked Team
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Low Gearing
fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 12% faster, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 5%.
